assets.caption: Elevation view of T-18 thermowell connection for NPS 1 thru 2 piping (horizontal run). Shows NPS 3 x NPS 1-1/2 Reducing Tee installed in NPS 1 thru NPS 2 line size piping with NPS 1-1/2 Weld Neck Flange on the branch and NPS 3 Line Size Reducer (eccentric with flat on bottom where required to keep line pocket-free) on the downstream side.

Elevation view of T-18 thermowell connection for NPS 1 thru 2 piping (vertical drop). Shows NPS 3 x NPS 1-1/2 Reducing Tee in NPS 1 thru NPS 2 line size piping with NPS 1-1/2 Weld Neck Flange and NPS 3 x NPS 1-1/2 Concentric Reducer on the upstream side, and NPS 3 x Line Size Concentric Reducer on the downstream side.
